column1: # The art catalog: every drawing in the app's library, one row each.
#   key      the library key a Pack names a drawing by
#   family   where it is at home: any, harbour, mars, street, ice
#   rung     how tall it stands beside a grown-up resident at its depth
#            ("tall 3.3", in P, the art bible's §3), or for a long, low
#   zone     where it is sited, from the water to the hills (the bible's
#            §2): water, quay, lanes, green, edge; "-" sites it by its shape
#   flags    "field" for what stands in a garden or a field (never taller
# Columns are separated by tabs. The world-gpui library paints each key
# (a test holds every row to a painter and every painter to a row), and
# systems/days sites each by its zone.
